programs.description: A 5-day hypertrophy split using only a barbell and dumbbells — no cables or machines. NASM muscular-development rep ranges throughout. Back day leans on horizontal rowing variety since there's no lat pulldown or pull-up bar available in a pure free-weight setup.

programs.description: A 4-day functional strength split using only a barbell and dumbbells. Built around real strength standards, explosive power, and loaded carries — classic free-weight athleticism.

A 4-day fat-loss split using only a barbell and dumbbells. Higher reps and shorter rest than a pure strength split, with two dedicated metabolic days — NASM Phase 1 Stabilization Endurance principles throughout.

A 4-day muscle-building split using bodyweight and the gym's rig — pull-up bar, dip station, rings. Skill-gated moves like muscle-ups are left out of the core lineup since they don't scale down for a true beginner; progress there is coached separately.

programs.description: A 3-day fat-loss circuit using bodyweight and the gym's rig. Higher reps, short rest, and a density-focused structure — the rig adds pulling variety a pure bodyweight session can't offer.

A 3-day full-body muscle-building rotation using zero equipment. No true pulling pattern is possible without a bar or rig, so this leans on unilateral squat/lunge work, varied push-up angles, and posterior-chain bridge/hinge work instead. Add rig-based pulling separately if any bar is available where you train.
